title: Only while running
prompt: The robot only covers ground while `running` is true, at 100 per second, counting `distance` from 0.0. After 60 frames at 60 per second, distance_while_running reports 100.
hints: An if on running inside _process decides whether this frame adds 100 times delta to distance.

docs.name: func _process(delta):
docs.what: Godot calls this once per frame, about 60 times a second. delta is the frame time in seconds.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A member variable keeps its value from one frame to the next.

docs.name: round(x)
docs.what: Returns the nearest whole number as a float.
